title: Vampire Vape Tropical Kiwi Cooler E-Liquid Shortfill 50ml
description: Kiwi Cooler 50ml Shortfill from Vampire Vape’s Tropical collection delivers a fresh citrus blend of Golden Kiwi and Tangelo with a subtle cooling finish. Golden Kiwi brings a soft, sweet tropical base, while Tangelo adds a sharp tangerine-grapefruit twist. The pairing feels light, juicy and vibrant, with a light cooling note that refreshes the exhale. It’s a bright, well-defined flavour made for smooth sub-ohm vaping. Blended at 70VG/30PG, this shortfill is ideal for direct-to-lung (DTL) vaping with sub-ohm kits. Add a 10ml nicotine shot to customise the strength to your preference. Vampire Vape e-liquids are made in the UK and respected for their bold, consistent flavour. The Tropical collection showcases adventurous pairings for all-day vaping. Also available in Nic Salt, Freebase and Concentrate formats.
